thought.text: Core endpoints work. The 400 on the auth endpoint is expected without query params. Let me verify Keycloak login flows with the documented dev users.

reasoning_content: Frontend, tRPC, and JWKS are all working. The `/kc/realms/startuphafen/protocol/openid-connect/auth` endpoint is returning 400 without query parameters — since the auth endpoint requires query parameters like client_id, redirect_uri, etc., this is probably expected. Let's test the actual Keycloak login flow using password grants for alice and admin, just as the installation summary claims. I'll also check the login page in a different way.

action.command: echo "=== alice password grant ==="; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:28080/realms/startuphafen/protocol/openid-connect/token -d "grant_type=password&client_id=startuphafen&username=alice&password=alice"; echo "=== admin (admin-cli) password grant ==="; curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:28080/realms/master/protocol/openid-connect/token -d "grant_type=password&client_id=admin-cli&username=admin&password=admin" | head -c 300; echo; echo "=== marie password grant ==="; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:28080/realms/startuphafen/protocol/openid-connect/token -d "grant_type=password&client_id=startuphafen&username=marie&password=marie"
